title: Flood, Democratic Republic of the Congo, 8 May 2023 (FL20230508COD)
description:
UNOSAT geodata for Flood, Democratic Republic of the Congo, 8 May 2023 (FL20230508COD), from 4 datasets on the Humanitarian Data Exchange. HDX describes the event:

**UNOSAT code FL20230508COD, GDACS Id: 1101981**  This map illustrates the potentially damaged structures/buildings affected by landslides in Chabondo village, Kalehe Territory, Sud-Kivu Province, DR. of the Congo as detected from a Pleiades image acquired on the 09th May 2023.
Within the extent of this map, at least 544 structures appear to be affected or potentially affected by landslides.
This is a preliminary analysis and has not yet been validated in the field. Please send ground feedback to the United Nations Satellite Centre (UNOSAT).

HDX datasets:

- [Damage assessment in Chabondo village, Kalehe Territory, Sud-Kivu Province, DR. of the Congo as of 09 May 2023](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/damage-assessment-in-chabondo-village-kalehe-territory-sud-kivu-province-dr-of-the-congo-a)
- [Damage assessment in Nyabibwe Town, Kalehe Territory, Sud-Kivu Province, DR. of the Congo as of 09 May 2023](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/damage-assessment-in-nyabibwe-town-kalehe-territory-sud-kivu-province-dr-of-the-congo-as-o)
- [Impact des glissements de terrain le 7 mai 2023 en Territoire de Kalehe, Province du Sud-Kivu, République Démocratique du Congo](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/impact-des-glissements-de-terrain-le-7-mai-2023-en-territoire-de-kalehe-province-du-sud-ki)
